messages:
Priya: Deloitte asked for a compact evidence bundle for KMS rotations + RBAC drift over the last 180 days. They want machine-readable artifacts, redaction notes, and a short timeline per rotation. Need to deliver by EOD Friday.
Nate: We can produce CloudTrail export, git policy diffs, IAM role-policy snapshots, and k8s rolebinding dumps. We'll also include smoke-test logs for any post-rotation validation.
Auditor_Deloitte: For SOC 2/ISO we need: (1) rotation timestamps and approvers, (2) principals with decrypt permission before/after, (3) any incident tickets that triggered emergency rotations, and (4) proof of post-rotation validation. Machine-readable preferred.
Priya: Plan: 
1) CloudTrail: lookup CreateKey/RotateKey/UpdateKeyPolicy/CreateGrant events for 180 days.
2) Git: commit IDs that changed infra/kms-policies with diffs.
3) IAM: snapshot roles/policies that include kms:Decrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey.
4) EKS IRSA: annotate serviceaccounts -> role mapping across clusters.
5) Manifest CSV + sha256 for each artifact + redaction_map.
Nate: CLI snippets I used: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-09-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z > ct_rotate_180d.json
git log --pretty=format:'%H %an %ad %s' -- infra/kms-policies/ --since='2025-09-01' --until='2026-03-01' > kms_commits.log
kubectl get sa --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, ns:.metadata.namespace, ann:.metadata.annotations}' > irsa_annotations.json
```
Priya: Note: do NOT include key material. Redact usernames/emails in identity_map.csv; provide mapping via secure SFTP if auditor needs it.
Nate: There was an emergency rotation on 2026-01-28 for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/emerg-1 due to vuln triage CVE-2026-4444. Ticket: SEC-404. Post-rotation smoke test run: smoke_decrypt_20260128.log (all decrypts succeeded).
Auditor_Deloitte: Include grant lifecycle details (who created grant, grantId, create/delete timestamps). If you can annotate which deployments used temporary grants that's helpful.
Priya: Will add a grants.csv with create/delete events and attach sample CloudWatch request/response entries. Also include the SOP pointer and the JIRA approval comments snapshot.
evidence_bot: evidence-bundle-1725006789 started. Expect ~5m. :package: 
Nate: Manifest format we'll use: artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
Example row:
artifact_type,source,timestamp,evidence_file,sha256,redacted
cloudtrail,aws,2026-01-28T14:12:03Z,ct_rotate_20260128.json,ab54f6c5d3e9f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0,false
Priya: ops: are we comfortable listing full role ARNs in the bundle? They're required for mapping but sensitive.
Auditor_Deloitte: Role ARNs OK. Please replace human emails with employee IDs and provide the mapping on the secure channel. Also request attestations if you redact any approver names.
Nate: Uploaded artifacts to the bundle and added redaction_map.csv. Bundle link: https://s3.internal.company/evidence/1725006789_kmsrbac.tar.gz sha256: c0ffee1234567890deadbeefcafebabefeedfacecafebabec0ffee1234567890
Priya: Drafting cover note to auditor with bundle link, manifest, and SFTP instructions for identity mapping. Will call out SEC-404 + smoke test artifacts.
Auditor_Deloitte: Received initial package, starting validation. May ping for a short walkthrough on IRSA mapping for service "reporting-worker".
Nate: I can join a quick call at 15:30 PT to walk through it.
Priya: Thanks team. Once auditor confirms, we'll mark this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
